key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AAE2
name: dispatch_indexed_handler_call
description: Reads a 16-bit index from a global, subtracts one, scales it by four to fetch a pointer from a fixed table, and passes that pointer to another routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AB02
name: configure_display_channel_state
description: Stores a pointer and clears a field in a display structure, makes several library calls with it using a size of 24 bytes, sets a 16-bit global to 57344, and sets a state byte to two.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AB6C
name: set_display_mode_three
description: Stores a pointer in a global, sets a 16-bit global to 49152 and a state byte to three, and makes two routine calls around that update.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AB8E
name: loop_descending_value_steps
description: Counts down from 100 to 0 in steps of five. Each step calls a routine with the current value, zero and a fixed buffer, then makes a library call with one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:ABC0
name: loop_ascending_value_steps
description: Counts up from 0 to 100 in steps of five. Each step calls a routine with the current value, zero and a fixed buffer, then makes a library call with one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:ABF6
name: clear_structure_position_fields
description: Clears two 16-bit fields at offsets 10 and 8 in the structure that a global pointer references, then calls a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AC16
name: run_fixed_setup_call_sequence
description: Copies a 32-bit global into another global, then makes a fixed sequence of routine calls with small constants and one value read from a global. It sets one 16-bit global and ends with two more calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AC90
name: append_table_entry_record
description: Fills a record buffer for the given index from a table, writing a scaled word, three bytes and a running position at offsets returned by repeated calls. While the position stays within 78000 bytes of a base, it emits an eight-unit block and advances the position.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AE00
name: copy_template_into_slot
description: Selects a 56-byte slot by index and releases it through a library call if it is already in state two. It then copies a 14-long template into the slot, stores scaled position values and state two, and passes the slot to a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AE82
name: copy_template_to_fixed_record
description: Copies a 14-long template from a global buffer into a fixed local record, sets a 32-bit field to zero and a 16-bit field to nine, and makes a library call with the record.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AEAE
name: forward_call_to_handler
description: Passes control to one other routine and returns. It stores nothing and reads no globals.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AEBA
name: reset_record_and_forward_fields
description: Calls a library function on a fixed local structure, clears a 16-bit field in it, then passes five values read from a per-index table entry to a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AF34
name: conditionally_forward_slot_call
description: Returns early when the slot is in state two and a library check reports zero. Otherwise it calls a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:AF5A
name: load_song_offset_table
description: Opens the file named songs through library calls and reads up to 28 length-prefixed segments. It records each segment's buffer offset in a table and loads segment data until a 5900-byte total is reached, then closes the file.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B006
name: setup_display_when_flag_clear
description: When a flag byte is zero, calls a library function with 350 and sets up a 320 by 200 structure. It passes two supplied handles to a second library call and makes two follow-up calls when a check returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B094
name: render_rows_from_tables
description: Loops over 22 rows, reading a step value and an offset from tables, and draws each row with block transfer library calls as either a column of tiles or one block. Rows with a nonzero table byte also trigger a library call with that byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B358
name: poll_input_and_store_match
description: Calls a library function and stores in a flag byte whether its result equals 32, then returns that same result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B37A
name: relocate_buffer_above_limit
description: Returns the pointer unchanged when it is 2097151 or lower. Above that limit it allocates a new block of the requested size through a library call, copies the bytes into it and returns the new block.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B3C0
name: render_quad_via_temp_bitmap
description: Works out the four corners of a quadrilateral from a 16-entry offset table and sets two sign flags from cross products. It draws the corner points into a temporary bitmap through library calls, then restores the saved buffer pointers.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B702
name: reset_counter_and_forward_copy
description: Sets a 16-bit counter global to two, copies a 128-byte buffer through a routine, and makes an indexed call. It copies the counter into another global when the counter exceeds three.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B764
name: copy_record_fields_to_globals
description: Copies two 16-bit values from a 22-byte record selected by index into fixed globals, adds ten to the second value, stores the byte argument at a fixed offset, and sets a flag byte to one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B7A6
name: update_flagged_slot_byte
description: Chooses a record offset with a library call, using one of two bases depending on the high bit of a flag byte. A byte at offset four of the record becomes 29 if it holds 15, otherwise the argument is stored at offset five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B7EE
name: update_indexed_slot_byte
description: Picks a record offset from a global index and a library call result. The byte at offset four becomes 29 if it holds 15, otherwise the data register byte is stored at offset five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B81C
name: store_byte_at_offset_five
description: Writes the byte held in a data register into the field five bytes past the address held in an address register, then returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B828
name: spawn_records_and_scan_points
description: When a table entry is zero and a counter exceeds nine, creates ten records at random positions that a library test accepts, then marks the entry done. It then walks a list of points, updating or appending records for points inside screen bounds.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B878
name: seed_records_and_scan_list
description: Creates ten records at random positions when a table entry is zero and a counter exceeds nine, then walks a point list through a stack pointer, updating or appending records for points inside screen bounds.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:B982
name: scan_point_list_for_records
description: Walks a list of six-byte points while the remaining count is positive, checking each against screen bounds. It updates or appends a matching record for each point inside the bounds.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BA80
name: scan_point_list_mid_entry
description: Enters the same point-list walk partway through its body and returns once the remaining count is exhausted.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BA84
name: advance_to_onscreen_point
description: Skips points that lie outside screen bounds, then updates or appends a matching record for the first point inside them. It repeats while the count remains.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BB30
name: append_onscreen_point_records
description: Walks a point list and, for each point inside screen bounds, writes a record with a value of fifteen for type-four points and thirteen otherwise. An existing record with the same position is reused.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BBA0
name: append_point_records_when_mismatch
description: Walks a point list and appends a record for each point inside bounds whose stored position differs. The value is fifteen for type-four points and thirteen otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BBDA
name: mark_or_append_point_records
description: Walks a point list and marks a matching record as type four when its value is fifteen. Otherwise it appends a record for each point inside bounds.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BC4C
name: append_point_records_by_type
description: Appends records for points inside bounds, with type zero for type-five points and one otherwise, and walks the list until the count is exhausted.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BC62
name: append_typed_point_records
description: Appends records for points inside bounds, setting the type field to two for type-six points, zero for type-five points and one otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BCA4
name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it performs no work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BCD8
name: read_and_match_typed_line
description: Reads printable characters into a nine-byte buffer until a carriage return, handling backspace. It compares the line with entries in a three-slot table, clearing a slot on match, and returns zero on the first mismatch or one after three matches.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BD7A
name: read_and_match_typed_input
description: Reads a line of printable characters with backspace editing and compares it against stored table entries. It clears each matched entry and returns one after three matches or zero on a mismatch.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BD8A
name: read_typed_input_and_match
description: Accepts printable characters into a nine-byte buffer with backspace support and matches the line when a carriage return arrives. It clears matched table entries, counts matches, and returns one after three or zero on a mismatch.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BDBA
name: match_stored_entry_then_read
description: Compares the current line with a table entry and clears the entry on a match. It then reads keyboard input for the next entry and returns one after three matches or zero on a mismatch.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BDDC
name: compare_entry_then_read_next
description: Compares the current line with a table entry, clears the entry when it matches, and reads keyboard input for the next entry. It returns one after three matches or zero on the first mismatch.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BDDE
name: clear_entry_and_rematch_input
description: Clears the matched table entry and counts the match, returning one after three matches. Otherwise it selects the next filled entry, reads keyboard input into the nine-byte buffer, and returns zero when the line does not match.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BDFE
name: call_library_teardown_sequence
description: Calls three functions on the system library base, then calls two functions on a stored library base and repeats that pair once more. It returns the two register values it was given.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BE62
name: call_and_forward_nonzero_result
description: Calls a routine with two arguments and stores its result in a global. When the result is nonzero it passes that value to a second routine, and it returns the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BE90
name: probe_df0_device_value
description: Calls a routine with the text df0 and a minus-two argument and stores the returned value. When that value is nonzero it compares a value reached through pointers with 230 before calling a second routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BEEC
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Contains only a bad-instruction marker, so it is not executable code and performs no work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BEF0
name: wait_for_flag_with_timeout
description: Polls a flag byte up to 300 times, waiting five units between checks. It clears the flag and returns one when it is set, or returns zero if it never is.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BEFA
name: poll_flag_clear_until_timeout
description: Checks a flag byte and clears it, returning one, when it is set. Otherwise it waits five units and retries until 300 attempts have passed, then returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BF0A
name: wait_then_poll_flag_timeout
description: Waits five units before each check of a flag byte. It clears the flag and returns one when it is set, or returns zero after 300 attempts.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BF24
name: transfer_game_state_to_file
description: Builds a file name from a fixed drive prefix and a letter, opens it in a mode chosen by a flag, then passes each state table and its size to a routine. It closes the file afterwards, or calls a fallback routine if the file cannot be opened.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BF54
name: transfer_state_to_winpic
description: Loops until an entry is available, then builds a file name from a letter and the df0 winpic prefix. It opens the file, passes the state blocks and their sizes to a routine, and closes it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BF80
name: prompt_writable_disk_and_save
description: Loops over prompts asking for a writable disk, then runs the save sequence: it opens a letter-named file, passes the game state blocks and their sizes to a routine, and closes the file. It leaves the loop on the abort path, which uses the text Aborted.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BFA0
name: save_state_after_disk_check
description: Checks for a disk in a loop, then sets a letter into the file name, opens the file, passes the game state blocks and their sizes to a routine, and closes it. It returns through the common cleanup path.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BFA2
name: save_letter_named_game_file
description: Writes a letter into the file name, opens the file in a mode chosen by a flag, then passes the game state blocks and their sizes to a routine. It closes the file and runs the common cleanup.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:BFCC
name: save_default_game_file
description: Opens the save file under its fixed name in mode 1005, passes the game state blocks and their sizes to a routine, and closes it. It returns without a letter prefix.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C0AC
name: report_save_failure
description: Runs the save step and, when it fails, passes the text ERROR: Couldn't save game. to a routine. It then runs the common cleanup and waits for a final request.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C0CC
name: report_load_failure
description: Passes the text ERROR: Couldn't load game. to a routine, runs the common cleanup, and waits for a final request. It leaves the loop once that request returns nonzero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C126
name: retry_winpic_request_until_ready
description: Sets a request flag when a related byte is clear, then loops on a routine call with the df0 winpic name until it returns nonzero. It calls two routines to finish.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C156
name: prompt_game_disk_until_ready
description: Shows the text Please insert GAME disk. and repeats a request until it returns nonzero. It then finishes through two routine calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C166
name: forward_single_library_call
description: Makes one library call with a stored pointer and a stored value, then returns with no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C216
name: transfer_block_with_error_check
description: Calls the library transfer function on the stored handle with two arguments, using a second routine instead when a flag byte is set. When the result is negative it calls a routine and stores the returned value as an error marker.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C23A
name: transfer_frame_args_check
description: Calls the library transfer function on the stored handle with two arguments taken from the caller's frame and stores the result. When that result is negative it calls a routine to record an error.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C264
name: set_rectangle_bounds_from_center
description: Stores a rectangle in a 12-byte slot selected by index, with its left and right edges 250 units from a given center x and its top and bottom edges 200 units from a given center y.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C2BE
name: run_indexed_display_sequence
description: Runs a sequence of library calls keyed to an index counter, with fixed pauses between steps, and updates several state values. It adds three to each byte in a six-byte region.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C3E6
name: animate_winpic_column_steps
description: Loads the winpic picture, then loops from 25 down to minus 30, rebuilding a 28-entry set of values from a table on each step with pauses between steps. It finishes with a final pause and copies a 32-byte block.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C4A6
name: repeat_column_animation_steps
description: Clears a 16-bit slot and rebuilds a 28-entry set of values from a table on each step, pausing between steps. It returns once the step counter falls below minus 29.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C4D2
name: run_column_steps_nested
description: Sets two stored values from a random source on each outer pass, then runs the column steps with a rebuilt table and pauses between them. It returns when the step counter falls below minus 29.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C562
name: select_value_by_flag_byte
description: Returns ten when the byte at the given index in a table is nonzero, otherwise eight.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C574
name: render_tracked_position_if_due
description: When a masked flag is zero or a byte exceeds 97, passes a position to a routine. Below index eight the position comes from globals with a 200-unit offset when a flag is set, otherwise a fixed 100 on each axis, and the routine's result is returned.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C588
name: render_tracked_position_plain
description: When a masked flag is zero or a byte exceeds 97, passes a position computed from a global to a routine. Once the index passes eight it uses a fixed position of 100 on each axis, and it returns the routine's result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C5D2
name: render_fixed_position_once
description: Calls a routine with the fixed values 100, 100, 100 and 1 and a buffer, then returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C5F4
name: dispatch_actor_action_code
description: Stores a value in an actor record and branches on an action code from one to ten. Each branch calls a routine with fixed position globals, sets a field from a masked library value, or for code eight compares distance and picks one of two routines.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C614
name: dispatch_actor_action_register
description: Stores the action code in a record byte and branches on codes one to ten. Codes one, three, five and ten call a routine, code four sets a masked field, and code eight compares distance before choosing a routine. It returns the last routine result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C646
name: dispatch_actor_action_tail
description: Handles the action branches for codes eight, four, three, five, two, six and ten using preset registers. Code eight uses the distance test, and the routine returns nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C678
name: dispatch_actor_action_flagged
description: Dispatches action codes eight, four, three, five, two, six and ten. Routines for codes three, five, two, six and ten run only when a flag argument is nonzero, while code eight and code four always run their own updates.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C724
name: forward_to_action_routine
description: Calls one action routine and returns, with no other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C744
name: dispatch_actor_action_short
description: Dispatches action codes four, three, five, two, six and ten, running the routine for each only when a flag argument is nonzero. Code four always sets a constant value and a masked field.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C768
name: dispatch_actor_codes_from_three
description: Handles action codes three, five, two, six and ten. Code two marks a record when its index matches, code ten always sets a constant, and the other routines run only when a flag argument is nonzero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C796
name: dispatch_actor_codes_from_five
description: Handles action codes five, two, six and ten. Code two marks a record when its index matches, code ten always sets a constant, and codes five, six and ten run their routines only when a flag argument is nonzero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C7C4
name: dispatch_actor_codes_from_two
description: Handles action codes two, six and ten. Code two marks a record when its index matches, and codes two, six and ten run their routines only when a flag argument is nonzero, with code ten also setting a constant.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C81E
name: dispatch_actor_codes_six_ten
description: Handles action codes six and ten. Code six runs its routine only when a flag argument is nonzero, and code ten always sets a constant while running its routine only with the flag.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C836
name: run_table_action_if_flagged
description: When a flag argument is nonzero, takes an index from a library call and passes a table value offset by 20 to a routine. It then calls a second routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C87A
name: apply_code_ten_action
description: When the action code is ten, it calls a routine if a flag argument is nonzero, then sets a byte at offset 16 of the record to 12.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C8A8
name: decrement_counter_and_notify
description: Subtracts the argument from a 16-bit counter global. When the counter drops below zero it clamps it to zero and calls a routine with 13, otherwise it calls a routine with a fixed buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C8CA
name: forward_yum_message_call
description: Passes a global buffer associated with the text Yum! to a routine and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:C904
name: load_matching_record_and_scan
description: Opens a file in mode 1005 and matches a stored key against a list of records, reading the matching data from the file. It then passes five stride-scaled positions to a routine, closes the file and returns one, or returns zero if the file cannot be opened or nothing matches.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:CB9E
name: advance_sequence_position
description: Clears a byte at offset one of a structure and adds a 16-bit value from offset two into a 32-bit field at offset 16. When the first byte is zero it calls a routine four times, then returns the pair of register values it was given.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:CBCA
name: step_audio_sequence_channel
description: Advances a channel's sequence when its timer has run out, processing command pairs: 129 loads a table value, 144 sets a value, and 255 ends the sequence, looping when its argument is nonzero. A note byte sets the channel's pointer, length and value from table entries.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:CEE6
name: decrement_count_and_set_state
description: Sets two 16-bit fields in a structure to 256, then decrements a counter byte in a second structure if it is nonzero. When the counter reaches zero it writes two more fields, and it sets a further word to 33024.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:CF1C
name: start_audio_channel_one
description: Writes the pointer, length, period and volume registers for audio channel one, then sets its DMA enable bits in the custom chip. It also clears the channel's pending interrupt request and sets two state bytes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:CF70
name: silence_audio_channel_one
description: Clears the low bit of a state byte, sets the channel one volume register to zero, and sets its period register to two.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:CF9C
name: store_four_longs_into_globals
description: Stores four 32-bit arguments into four fixed global slots, one argument per slot, and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:CFC2
name: reset_all_audio_channels
description: Clears the volume registers of all four audio channels and copies the first four words of a sample table into channel state. It clears the channel state fields and enables DMA for channels zero to three.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D07E
name: mute_all_audio_channels
description: Zeroes the volume registers of all four audio channels and sets a state byte to 255. It then disables DMA for channels zero to three by clearing their enable bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D0A4
name: install_music_interrupt_servers
description: Fills two interrupt structures with a handler and registers them through exec calls for the audio 4 and music vblank entries. It then clears a pending interrupt request and disables the matching interrupt bit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D14E
name: remove_music_interrupt_server
description: Calls a routine, then removes the music interrupt server through an exec call. It sets a 16-bit field to 256 in the audio structure and calls a second exec function to restore the interrupt vector.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D17E
name: clear_table_store_slot_data
description: Computes a slot offset from a global index, sets a 16-bit field, and zeroes a block of 944 longs in a table. It then stores a pointer and a value into the slot and calls a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D1C8
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return, so it performs no work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D1CE
name: run_command_line_with_arguments
description: Opens the dos library and calls a routine with a fixed error code if that fails. Otherwise it splits a command line into quoted or space-separated words, builds an array of pointers to them, and makes library calls to run the command with those arguments.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D4C0
name: copy_string_pad_zeros
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination up to a counted limit or a zero terminator, then fills the rest of the counted length with zeros. It returns the destination pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D4E2
name: append_string_bounded
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most 32766 bytes and terminating the result. It returns the destination pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D4E8
name: copy_string_with_limit
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, stopping at the zero terminator or when the counter argument runs out. It writes a terminator after the copied text when the copy was cut short, and returns the destination pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D50C
name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated source string, including its terminator, into the destination buffer. It returns the destination pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D51C
name: multiply_low_32_bits
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values by splitting each into 16-bit halves and summing the cross products. It returns the low 32 bits of the product in the high word of the 64-bit result, with the second input in the low word.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D540
name: call_with_sign_correction
description: Works out the sign of the result from the signs of two inputs, then calls a routine and negates its result when the signs differ. It returns the result with the second input in the low word.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D568
name: negate_when_first_negative
description: Calls a routine, then negates the value it leaves in the second register when the first input is negative. It returns that value in the high word of the 64-bit result, with the second input in the low word.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D582
name: call_and_return_concatenated
description: Calls a routine and returns a 64-bit value made from the second register as left by the call, with the original second register in the low word.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D58E
name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns, doing nothing else in its body.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D598
name: divide_32_bit_values
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor, using a 16-step shift-and-subtract loop when the divisor's high half is set and 16-bit divide steps otherwise. It returns the quotient and remainder in a 64-bit result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D5E8
name: compute_string_length
description: Walks a zero-terminated byte string to find its terminator and returns the number of bytes before it. It does not change memory.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D5FA
name: invoke_optional_hook_then_run
description: Calls a stored function pointer from a global slot when that slot is set, then calls a second routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D618
name: release_stored_resources
description: Runs a 20-step loop calling a routine, then releases three stored resources through library calls when they are set. Depending on a stored handle, it then calls two routines with stored values or calls a routine with the handle.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D6CC
name: release_indexed_slot_resource
description: Checks that the index is between 0 and 19 and that its slot is set, otherwise it records error code three and returns minus one. Otherwise it releases the slot's resource through a routine unless its flag has the high bit set, clears the slot, and returns zero.

description: Requests a free index, then allocates a 34-byte record through a library call. On success it stores the arguments, a type value of four, the index and a library-supplied value into the record and calls a routine for it, and it returns the record; on failure it releases the index and returns zero.

name: release_slot_record
description: Releases a record allocated earlier by calling a routine on its linked field when that field is set and marking its state and index as unused. It then calls a routine with the index and frees the 34-byte block through a library call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D924
name: call_library_with_size_48
description: Passes its argument and the value 48 to a library function loaded from a stored base, then returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D93A
name: forward_library_call_with_argument
description: Passes its argument to a library function loaded from a stored base, then returns.

name: allocate_typed_record_block
description: When the pointer argument is nonzero, allocates a block of the requested size through a library call. It sets a type value of five, stores the size and the argument pointer into the block, and returns the block, or zero when the allocation fails.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a4]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a4].adf:fmain:0:D990
name: release_typed_record_block
description: When the pointer is nonzero, marks the record's state and two link fields as unused and frees its block through a library call. It returns the library result, or zero when the pointer is null.

name: mark_record_unused_and_free
